setup.title: First-time setup
setup.subtitle: 3 steps, a few minutes. Everything is stored on this machine.

license.title: Get started
license.email_hint: One free license per machine and email.
license.key_hint: You get it after subscribing. Move between machines with the same key.
license.beta_desc: Free during the beta, no card needed. It won't be free forever: we'll announce the end at least 10 days ahead, and your license keeps working until the end of that month.
license.trial_desc: Free {hours}-hour trial, no card needed. The clock starts at your first question, not during setup.

ai.title: Connect AI
ai.desc: Bring your own key and pay the provider directly. We add no markup.
ai.mode_gemini_desc: Simplest. One key for answering and document search.
ai.mode_both_desc: Separate providers for answering and document search. Needs 2 keys.
ai.gemini_help: Create one free in Google AI Studio
ai.privacy_note: Note: on Gemini's free tier Google may use your data to improve its services. Use a paid key for sensitive data.

password.title: Admin password
password.desc: Stops others on your network from changing settings. Recommended if other machines can open this page.
password.from_env: The password is already set in this machine's config file.
password.login_note: After this, your browser will ask for the username and password.

finish.title: You're ready
finish.desc: Next: create a knowledge base and upload your documents, then create a bot and start asking.

errors.demo_used: This machine or email has already used the trial. Subscribe to continue with the same key.
errors.credential_invalid: The API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check that you copied all of it.
errors.provider_quota_exhausted: The API key is out of quota or credit.
errors.central_unreachable: Can't reach central. Check your internet connection.
errors.tunnel_offline: The local database isn't connected to central yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.device_replaced: This license was last activated on another machine.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Let your customers talk to the bot in your existing LINE Official Account. No open ports or domain needed.

status.replaced: Another machine is using this license

line.title: LINE Official Account
line.desc: The bot answers text messages in one-to-one chats only. Stickers, images and groups get no reply. Replies are free and unlimited.
line.step1: Open LINE Developers, create a Provider and a Messaging API channel (or use your existing Official Account's).
line.step2: Copy the Channel secret (Basic settings tab) and issue a long-lived Channel access token (Messaging API tab), then paste both below.
line.step3: Click Add channel, copy the Webhook URL into the Messaging API tab, press Verify, then turn on Use webhook.
line.step4: In LINE Official Account Manager, Response settings: turn off Auto-response messages, or they will overlap with the bot.
line.keep: Leave empty to keep the current value
line.confirm_delete: Delete this channel? Customers can't talk to the bot in LINE until you add it again.
line.welcome: Send a welcome message when someone adds the account
line.not_https: The configured central address is not https://. LINE only delivers webhooks to public https addresses.
line.no_bots: No bots yet. Create one on the Chatbots page first.
line.pc_note: The program must be running and online for the bot to answer. While the machine is off, messages get no reply.

notice.beta_ending: The free beta ends on {date}. Renew before then to keep using this license. Your data stays as it is.
notice.beta_ended: The free beta has ended, so answering is paused. Renew to continue with the same license. Your data is still here.
